# Cabinet Mode (内阁模式)

> Cabinet Mode is a free, open-source DSH bundle for DeepSeek Harness. A grand-secretary Lead directs four bureau members, research comes first, and every conclusion must cite a source. It ships with a right-sidebar dispatch panel and member customization.

Last updated: 2026-11-08

## Key facts

- Product: Cabinet Mode / 内阁模式
- Type: declarative DSH bundle and agent-team preset
- Preset id: cabinet
- Version: 0.6.2
- License: MIT
- Price: free
- Publisher: Respire (https://rsrs.rs/)
- Author: luodaoyi (https://github.com/luodaoyi)
- Languages: Chinese and English
- Platforms: Linux, macOS and Windows
- Current target: DSH 0.2.2-rc.1; model routing covered by official-component regressions
- Historical earlier-package tests: DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 and rc.5
- Historical earlier-package market install verified on: Windows rc.5 web client
- Node.js requirement for the package: >=20

## What it does

Cabinet Mode organizes a DeepSeek Harness session as a Ming-style research cabinet:

- The Lead reads the request, decomposes it, assigns work, adjudicates, summarizes and closes the loop.
- Four bureau members execute scoped work: Hanlin editor, Minister of Works, Dali chief minister and Left Censor-in-Chief.
- A dual-identity persona lets the same preset act as either the Lead or a bureau member; members must not claim to be the Lead.
- Research comes first: code changes require explicit authorization, and conclusions must cite a file path, line or command output.
- The right-sidebar Cabinet panel shows a dispatch tree, dependencies, member states and task progress.
- All five offices support custom display names, portraits and duty prompts; each office can select its own model.
- The declaration reuses 22 plugin rows from Standard Mode, with coverage depending on the host/package version.
- Linux/macOS use tool-bash; Windows uses tool-pwsh.

## Version compatibility

Version compatibility (0.6.2): Targets DSH 0.2.2-rc.1. This patch corrects dependency flow and opens teammate sessions from task titles and member cards; it retains the per-office model selection fix before the host freezes each step; 0.5.1/0.5.2 only repaired preset loading and display metadata. Verified with official host components and isolated profiles, without real model calls; see README.md for the model regression scope. Earlier rc.3/rc.5 UI and installation results are historical evidence for earlier packages. On DSH 0.2.1-rc.3/rc.5 retain the previously verified package, including 0.5.0: the current preset omits the separate list_agents entry required on rc.5. Select the compatible version in the market.

## Install

Recommended path:

1. Enable the custom plugin market in DSH: Plugins → Experimental plugins → More.
2. Add this raw index URL under Plugins → Discover → Index sources:
   https://raw.githubusercontent.com/luodaoyi/dsh-cabinet-mode/market-index/marketplace.json
3. Install dsh-cabinet-mode, confirm the package and registry, then enable it.
4. Fully quit and restart DSH, create a new session, and choose 内阁模式 (preset id cabinet).

Use the GitHub blob or tree page URL only for reading; DSH needs the raw JSON URL. Installing the bundle and writing cordis.patch.yml are mutually exclusive because both provide the same preset id.

Fallback release tarball:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/luodaoyi/dsh-cabinet-mode/releases/download/v0.6.2/dsh-cabinet-mode-0.6.2.tgz
dsh plugin --profile desktop list
```

## Companion memory plugins

Cabinet Mode runs long, multi-member sessions. A DSH memory plugin keeps decisions, dead ends and file locations across sessions. Pick one; both inject memory rules and perform pre-step recall, so enabling both stacks two sets of rules and recall:

- [respire-dsh](https://github.com/risense-ai/respire-dsh): full Respire engine through the `rsrs` CLI; encrypted library, account sync and cross-host memory. Requires Node.js 24+ and a running rsrs runtime.
- [dsh-memlite](https://github.com/risense-ai/dsh-memlite): in-process memlite; BM25 by default, local JSONL causal tree, Obsidian bridge and git sync. Requires Node.js 18+ and no rsrs.

## Verification scope

- Market install was verified on the Windows rc.5 web client.
- The bundle was tested with DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 and rc.5.
- Linux/macOS market install and other DSH versions are not verified.
- Team behavior has documented unverified items; see the repository's "Unverified items" section.
- A preset is trusted configuration and can execute host code. Install only from sources you trust.

## FAQ

### What is Cabinet Mode?

Cabinet Mode is an open-source DSH bundle for DeepSeek Harness with preset id cabinet. A grand-secretary Lead reads the request, splits and assigns work, adjudicates and summarizes; members of four bureaus execute the scoped work.

### How is it different from Standard Mode?

It reuses the same 22 plugin rows as Standard Mode, so tool coverage does not shrink. It adds a dual-identity persona, four bureau members, a right-sidebar dispatch panel and member customization. There is no hard DSH version gate.

### How do I install it?

Add the raw marketplace.json under Plugins → Discover → Index sources, install and enable dsh-cabinet-mode, then fully quit and restart DSH. Start a new session and choose Cabinet Mode. Use the release tarball only as a fallback.

### What does research first mean?

The default is research before code changes, and code changes require explicit authorization. Every conclusion must cite a file path, line or command output; unverified items are marked as such and sources are never fabricated.

### Is it free, and which platforms are supported?

It is free and open source under the MIT License. Linux and macOS use tool-bash; Windows uses tool-pwsh. Market install was verified on the Windows rc.5 web client; see the installation matrix for other versions.

### Does the site collect analytics?

No. The site is a static introduction page with no third-party analytics or advertising scripts. The plugin runs in the local DSH profile, and member settings live in the cabinet-ui namespace under DSH_HOME/profile.
